args.text:
Batch of 8 runs (r01–r08), all accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: all 8.
Checks: rigid-body invariance (0.74–0.80 vs 2.0 %/h) and closure (0.11 vs 1.0 px/h) passed in every run. Plane sections was not run because every run reported the width-free ratio. Its values of 3.79–3.86 %/h are above the 3.25 threshold, which is expected when root width changes.
Remedies: each run kept 1 remedy (report the width-free ratio). r05 and r06 each have 1 roll-back, and the final checks pass.
Summaries: the batch splits into two groups with the same values within each group. r01, r04, r05, r07 and r08: REGR peak 53.15 %/h at 421 µm, growth zone 695 µm, largest flank difference −3.86 %/h at 1074 µm. r02, r03 and r06: REGR peak 52.96 %/h at 421 µm, growth zone 684 µm, largest flank difference −3.79 %/h at 284 µm.
The centre strain-rate profiles of the two groups are nearly the same. The largest flank differences are almost equal in size but sit at different positions.
Follow-up: in r02, r03 and r06 the largest width-free ratio is negative (−0.019 at 50 µm, against 0.074 for the other group). Check the curvature-rate profile of these 3 runs before comparing curvature results across the batch.
